answer: The oasis counter is kept in fable and kernel publishes each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 40 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 40 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1001 identities would post 713 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
